lines.zh: 每一步都震得树叶簌簌落下
lines.en: Every step shakes the leaves loose
My huge feet crush the dead wood
A giant shadow drifts through the trees

lines.zh: 尾巴把挡路的灌木扫平
lines.en: My tail flattens the bushes in my way

lines.zh: 石地在我的体重下低鸣
lines.en: The stone groans under my weight
I follow the blood trail at a walk

lines.zh: 这具身体生来就该统治地面
lines.en: This body was born to rule the ground

lines.zh: 泥土被我踩出深深的坑
lines.en: I leave deep pits in the dirt
My jaws part and hot breath steams out

lines.zh: 骨头在我脚下咔咔作响
lines.en: Bones crack beneath my feet
Prey cannot escape, so I need not hurry

lines.zh: 我用肩膀把一棵树撞歪
lines.en: I lean a tree aside with my shoulder

lines.zh: 草原上只有我一个影子
lines.en: On this plain I am the only shadow

lines.zh: 老猎手都知道要绕开我的路
lines.en: Old hunters know to clear my path

lines.zh: 我站着不动，大地也安静
lines.en: I stand still, and the ground goes quiet
Two plumes of mist leave my nostrils

lines.zh: 脑袋微侧，听着远处动静
lines.en: Head tilted, I listen to the distance
Someone moves in the wind, and I know
I grind my teeth, unhurried
The sun rests warm on my back

lines.zh: 我的影子比整片林子都长
lines.en: My shadow is longer than the wood
A beast my size has no need to speak

lines.zh: 我盯着地平线，一动不动
lines.en: I stare at the horizon without moving
My tail taps the ground, slow and heavy
I count heartbeats like a war drum
Whoever moves first loses

lines.zh: 我在等一口足够大的猎物
lines.en: I wait for a meal big enough to matter

lines.zh: 站久了，脚下的草都断了
lines.en: Standing this long, the grass dies beneath me
You are scrawny, but I will eat you anyway

lines.zh: 抬头看我，你得仰得很高
lines.en: Look up at me, and you must look high

lines.zh: 你身上的味道让我好奇
lines.en: Your scent makes me curious
Little thing, daring to stand before me
I growl once, and you tremble

lines.zh: 你不是最大的，但就在眼前
lines.en: You are not the biggest, but you are here

lines.zh: 我歪头，像在估你的分量
lines.en: I tilt my head, weighing how much you are worth
Your flesh is a single mouthful

lines.zh: 我记得每个敢看我的脸
lines.en: I remember every face that dared look at me
Staring at me means you do not understand yet
I lower my head level with yours

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在找你的脖子
lines.en: My eyes are hunting for your neck
Who dares bite my leg
This pain is only a scratch

lines.zh: 我的皮很厚，你的牙很浅
lines.en: My hide is thick, your teeth are shallow
I roar once, and you back off
Blood slides down my ribs
I stumble half a step, then stand firm
It hurts, not enough to make me leave
I will remember that blow

lines.zh: 巨兽也会流血，但不会倒
lines.en: A tyrant bleeds, but does not fall
The price you pay will be heavier

lines.zh: 这块生肉的味道，我闻到了
lines.en: I catch the smell of that raw meat
Bring it here, do not dangle it at me
Meat — no word reaches me faster
Your hands shake, and so does the meat

lines.zh: 一大块肉能换我一时的平静
lines.en: A big cut of meat buys you my calm
I bend down and sniff at that meat
I will not thank you, but I will eat

lines.zh: 肉香把我肚子里的饥饿唤醒了
lines.en: The smell wakes the hunger in my belly
Do not run yet, set the meat down
Eating this is easier than chasing you
You hit my leg as if hitting a hillside

lines.zh: 让开，我的身体没空绕路
lines.en: Move, my body has no room to go around

lines.zh: 我轻轻一顶，你退了三步
lines.en: One nudge and you stagger back three steps

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我没学会轻
lines.en: Do not crowd me, I never learned gentle
I bumped you, and that was nothing
Bone against bone makes a dull sound

lines.zh: 我这身重量本身就是道理
lines.en: My weight is the argument

lines.zh: 撞一下就知道我是真的
lines.en: One bump and you will believe I am real
You kept your feet, so count yourself lucky

lines.zh: 下次我会把爪子也带上
lines.en: Next time I will bring my claws too

lines.zh: 这一带只有我这头暴龙
lines.en: Only one tyrant walks this land, and it is me

lines.zh: 同族的背影也让我心动
lines.en: Even a rival's back stirs something in me

lines.zh: 为了配偶，我们会打一场
lines.en: For a mate, we would fight a round

lines.zh: 我的叫声传得比森林更远
lines.en: My call carries further than the forest

lines.zh: 我闻到另一头暴龙的气味
lines.en: I smell another tyrant on the wind

lines.zh: 强壮的才有资格靠近我
lines.en: Only the strong may come near me

lines.zh: 我把尾巴竖起来，像面旗
lines.en: I raise my tail like a banner
Before pairing, we settle who wins

lines.zh: 我们的吼声能把鸟都惊走
lines.en: Our roaring empties the trees of birds

lines.zh: 同类相伴，也要留着敬畏
lines.en: Even kin together must keep their respect
I lift this little thing with my teeth
Loot? Just enough to pick at my teeth
I bend down and take it in my jaws
A small prize, and now it is mine
Do not laugh, my jaws can be steady
I toss it up onto my back
The bones are mine, and the meat too
I can carry it and still roar

lines.zh: 这么轻，我几乎感觉不到
lines.en: So light I barely feel it at all
The gaps in my teeth are not a rubbish bin

lines.zh: 那双腿跑得不错，我选你了
lines.en: Those legs run well, so you are chosen

lines.zh: 我转头，锁定了那个影子
lines.en: I turn my head and fix on that shadow

lines.zh: 风把你的气味送到我鼻前
lines.en: The wind delivers your scent to my nose
You, the one out in front

lines.zh: 我停下脚步，然后看向你
lines.en: I stop walking, then look at you
The target is big, and big is good
Decided — it is that breath of yours

lines.zh: 我的眼窝已经对准你的方向
lines.en: My eye socket has already found your direction

lines.zh: 心跳加快，猎物已在视野
lines.en: My heart speeds up, prey in sight
Do not expect me to change targets
I rumble low, as a declaration

lines.zh: 你逃跑的方向我看得一清二楚
lines.en: I see exactly which way you will flee
You are the only one here worth chasing

lines.zh: 追击就是从这一眼开始的
lines.en: The hunt begins with this one look

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把距离压短
lines.en: Step by step, I press the distance shut
I have memorized every print you left
Dodging trees will not help, I am patient
My roar is counting down for you
You run for the river, and I do not rush

lines.zh: 巨影一直贴着你的后背
lines.en: My shadow stays glued to your back
I can smell your sweat
Only a few steps left, and you still run
My legs are longer than you think
The more you panic, the steadier I get

lines.zh: 我的爪印盖住了你的脚印
lines.en: My prints swallow yours

lines.zh: 你回头看我，就慢了半拍
lines.en: Glancing back costs you half a beat
I stay silent, roaring wastes my strength

lines.zh: 这片地没有你能钻的洞
lines.en: No hole in this ground is big enough for you
The last few steps belong to my teeth

lines.zh: 巨口咬下，空气都被撕开
lines.en: My jaws snap and tear the air apart
My teeth land hard on you
One toss of my head throws you aside
My claw comes down and the ground splits

lines.zh: 你听见骨头的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear that sound of bone
This bite is only a reminder

lines.zh: 我这口牙，二十二点伤害。
lines.en: These teeth deal twenty-two damage.

lines.zh: 我的咬合力不需要第二次
lines.en: My bite does not need a second try
My jaws close like a heavy door
You are wearing a row of tooth marks now
I swing my tail and sweep you away
Do not dodge, my mouth follows
Bite and hold — that is instinct
The taste of blood excites me
I wake from deep within the strata

lines.zh: 六千万年，我又站起来了
lines.en: Sixty million years, and I stand again
The dust settles and I raise my head

lines.zh: 我的影子先出现在地上
lines.en: My shadow arrives on the ground before I do
The earth remembers my footsteps
A long roar slices the dusk open

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步，树都让开
lines.en: I take my first step and the trees give way

lines.zh: 从化石到血肉，我回来了
lines.en: From fossil to flesh, I have returned

lines.zh: 森林安静下来，因为我在
lines.en: The forest falls quiet because I am here

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻这个新世界
lines.en: I sniff at this new world first

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，试了试新的空气
lines.en: I open my jaws and test the new air

lines.zh: 巨兽的登场不需要介绍
lines.en: A beast like me needs no introduction
I trample the first bush flat

lines.zh: 这里的动物还不认识我
lines.en: The animals here do not know me yet
I turn slowly and claim this land
The hunting instinct is already awake
I walk out of the shadow
This land belongs to me from today

lines.zh: 火舌舔上我的背，我怒吼
lines.en: Flame licks my back and I roar

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，我的骨头在响
lines.en: Dropping from a height, my bones ring

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我拼命抬头
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I strain to rise
The blast knocks me onto my side
An arrow sticks in my shoulder
That magic burns inside my body
Hunger makes my legs go soft

lines.zh: 雷劈在我背上，鳞皮焦黑
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and scorches my hide

lines.zh: 虚空拖着我，脚下没有地
lines.en: The void pulls at me and there is no ground
